FOR YOUR BUSINESS

You run the business.
We care for the linen.

From guest linen to team uniforms. Six ways to keep your business feeling fresh.

Hospitality & Dining

Laundry care for hotels, B&Bs, restaurants and caterers in Hyderabad. Fresh bed linen, guest towels, tablecloths and staff uniforms.

Salons & Wellness

Care for salon, barber shop, spa, nail studio and massage linen in Hyderabad—from towels and robes to capes and treatment covers.

Healthcare & Assisted Living

Linen and garment care for assisted living homes and therapy practices in Hyderabad. Enquire about fabric types and specific cleaning needs.

Fitness & Sports

Laundry for Hyderabad gyms, athletic facilities and sports teams. Keep workout towels, training kits and jerseys ready for the next session.

Housekeeping & Workwear

Laundry care for cleaning teams, automotive detailers and repair shops in Hyderabad. Enquire about cleaning cloths, towels and everyday workwear.

Daycare & Pet Care

Fabric care for Hyderabad daycare centres and pet groomers. Enquire about nap bedding, washable covers, towels and staff workwear.

THE LITTLE THINGS, ANSWERED.

A clearer
laundry day.

How do I book a pickup?+

Use MagicKlean’s official order page or call +91 9393 931 947. The form in this design preview saves a local draft only.

What can I send for cleaning?+

Explore everyday laundry, dry cleaning, steam ironing, shoes, leather and suede, wedding garments, pillows and household textiles. Share fabric care instructions and special requirements with the team.

How is the price calculated?+

Laundry is priced by the kilogram, while garment care and steam ironing are priced per item. The published starting rates are shown above; confirm your final quote with MagicKlean.

Where can I find MagicKlean?+

The official contact page lists Khader Bagh, Upperpally and Puppalguda locations in Hyderabad. Choose a location on the map for directions, and call to confirm pickup coverage.

Do you care for business laundry?+

MagicKlean lists commercial laundry for hospitality, salons, care facilities, sports teams and other businesses. Use the business enquiry to describe the fabrics and volumes you need help with.
